metadata.description: Master hub for the SuperSynthLab Interactive Audio Synthesis Curriculum. Contains all 36 section exhibits and the SSL runtime embedded inline.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>SuperSynthLab -- Interactive Audio Synthesis Curriculum</title>
<style>
/* SuperSynthLab Presentation Hub -- Dark Synth Theme */

* {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

body {
  background: #0a0a0a;
  color: #EEEEEE;
  font-family: "Courier New", Courier, monospace;
  min-height: 100vh;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  padding-bottom: 120px;
}

/* -- Header ----------------------------------------- */

#hub-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 20px 30px;
  background: #111111;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #0088FF;
}

#header-title {
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #0088FF;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

#header-subtitle {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #999999;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

#header-tagline {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #0088FF;
  margin-top: 6px;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  opacity: 0.7;
}

#header-version {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #666666;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* -- Content Area ----------------------------------- */

#hub-content {
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 24px 20px;
}

/* -- Section Grid ----------------------------------- */

#section-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 16px;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  #section-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 560px) {
  #section-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

/* -- Tier Header ------------------------------------ */

.tier-header {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 12px 0 6px 4px;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #333333;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

/* -- Section Card ----------------------------------- */

.section-card {
  background: #1a1a1a;
  border: 1px solid #333333;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 16px 18px 14px 18px;
  position: relative;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.section-card::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 4px;
  border-radius: 6px 0 0 6px;
}

.section-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.section-card.active {
  border-color: #0088FF;
}

.card-top-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.card-number {
  font-size: 28px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #0088FF;
  line-height: 1;
  min-width: 36px;
}

.card-check {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid #444444;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: transparent;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.card-check.viewed {
  border-color: #00CC55;
  color: #00CC55;
  background: rgba(0, 204, 85, 0.1);
}

.card-title {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #EEEEEE;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.card-desc {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #999999;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.card-bottom-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}

.card-time {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #BBBBBB;
  background: #2a2a2a;
  border: 1px solid #444444;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 2px 10px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.card-status {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 2px 10px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.card-status-ready {
  color: #00CC55;
  background: rgba(0, 204, 85, 0.12);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 204, 85, 0.3);
}

.card-status-pending {
  color: #DD8855;
  background: rgba(221, 136, 85, 0.12);
  border: 1px solid rgba(221, 136, 85, 0.3);
}

/* -- Lecture Button --------------------------------- */

.card-lecture-btn {
  font-family: "Courier New", Courier, monospace;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: #CC44FF;
  background: rgba(204, 68, 255, 0.1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(204, 68, 255, 0.35);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 2px 10px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
}

.card-lecture-btn:hover {
  background: rgba(204, 68, 255, 0.25);
  color: #DD88FF;
}

/* -- Lab Button ------------------------------------- */

.card-lab-btn {
  font-family: "Courier New", Courier, monospace;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: #FFAA00;
  background: rgba(255, 170, 0, 0.1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 170, 0, 0.35);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 2px 10px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
}

.card-lab-btn:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 170, 0, 0.25);
  color: #FFCC44;
}

.card-lab-btn-done {
  color: #886600;
  border-color: rgba(136, 102, 0, 0.4);
  background: rgba(136, 102, 0, 0.1);
}

/* -- Complexity Badge ------------------------------- */

.card-complexity {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 2px 10px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* -- Modal Overlay --------------------------------- */

#modal-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  z-index: 2000;
  transition: opacity 0.2s;
}

#modal-overlay.modal-hidden {
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

#modal-overlay.modal-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

#modal-card {
  background: #1a1a1a;
  border: 2px solid #0088FF;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 32px 40px;
  max-width: 480px;
  width: 90%;
  text-align: center;
}

#modal-section-num {
  font-size: 48px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #0088FF;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

#modal-title {
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #EEEEEE;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

#modal-desc {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #999999;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

#modal-complexity {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

#modal-exhibit-label {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #666666;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

#modal-exhibit-id {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #0088FF;
  background: #0d0d1a;
  border: 1px solid #1a1a3a;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  word-break: break-all;
  user-select: all;
  cursor: text;
}

#modal-time {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #777777;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

#modal-close {
  padding: 8px 32px;
  font-size: 14px;
}

/* -- Embed Overlay --------------------------------- */

#embed-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  background: #0a0a0a;
  z-index: 3000;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  transition: opacity 0.2s;
}

#embed-overlay.embed-hidden {
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

#embed-overlay.embed-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

#embed-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  background: #111111;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #333333;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  height: 38px;
}

.embed-close-btn {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1px solid #FF5555;
  background: #331111;
  color: #FF7777;
  font-size: 16px;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: background 0.15s;
  line-height: 1;
  padding: 0;
  font-family: "Courier New", Courier, monospace;
}

.embed-close-btn:hover {
  background: #552222;
  color: #FF9999;
}

#embed-title {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #0088FF;
  font-weight: bold;
  flex: 1;
}

#embed-frame {
  flex: 1;
  width: 100%;
  border: none;
  background: #0a0a0a;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
}

/* -- Toast ------------------------------------------ */

#toast {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 90px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: #2a2a2a;
  color: #EEEEEE;
  border: 1px solid #555555;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 10px 24px;
  font-size: 13px;
  z-index: 1000;
  transition: opacity 0.3s;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.toast-hidden {
  opacity: 0;
}

.toast-visible {
  opacity: 1;
}

/* -- Presenter Toolbar ------------------------------ */

#presenter-toolbar {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  background: #111111;
  border-top: 1px solid #333333;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 10px 20px;
  z-index: 900;
  height: 56px;
}

.toolbar-btn {
  font-family: "Courier New", Courier, monospace;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #EEEEEE;
  background: #2a2a2a;
  border: 1px solid #555555;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 6px 16px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.15s;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.toolbar-btn:hover {
  background: #3a3a3a;
}

.toolbar-btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.4;
  cursor: default;
}

.toolbar-btn-danger {
  color: #FF7777;
  border-color: #663333;
}

.toolbar-btn-danger:hover {
  background: #331111;
}

#position-indicator {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #999999;
  white-space: nowrap;
  min-width: 140px;
  text-align: center;
}

#progress-bar-container {
  width: 200px;
  height: 8px;
  background: #2a2a2a;
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow: hidden;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

#progress-bar {
  height: 100%;
  background: #0088FF;
  border-radius: 4px;
  transition: width 0.3s;
  width: 0;
}

/* -- Script Button ---------------------------------- */

.toolbar-btn-script {
  color: #0088FF;
  border-color: #1a3a5a;
  background: #0d0d1a;
}

.toolbar-btn-script:hover {
  background: #1a1a3a;
}

/* -- Script Panel (Left Side) ----------------------- */

#script-panel {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 420px;
  background: #0a0a0a;
  border-right: 2px solid #1a3a5a;
  z-index: 2500;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  transform: translateX(-100%);
  transition: transform 0.25s ease;
}

#script-panel.script-visible {
  transform: translateX(0);
}

/* Shift everything right when script panel is open */
body.script-open #hub-header {
  margin-left: 420px;
}

body.script-open #hub-content {
  margin-left: 420px;
}

body.script-open #presenter-toolbar {
  left: 420px;
}

body.script-open #hub-footer {
  left: 420px;
}

body.script-open #embed-overlay {
  left: 420px;
}

body.script-open #modal-overlay {
  left: 420px;
}

body.script-open #toast {
  left: calc(50% + 210px);
}

#script-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  background: #111111;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #333333;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  height: 44px;
}

#script-title {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #0088FF;
  font-weight: bold;
  flex: 1;
}

#script-progress {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #666666;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

#script-content {
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 20px 16px 80px 16px;
}

#script-content > * {
  max-width: 100%;
  margin-left: 0;
  margin-right: 0;
}

#script-content p {
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: #CCCCCC;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

/* -- Script Section Headers ------------------------- */

.script-section-header {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #0088FF;
  margin: 24px 0 8px 0;
  padding-bottom: 6px;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #1a3a5a;
}

.script-subsection-header {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #EEEEEE;
  margin: 16px 0 6px 0;
}

/* -- Script Exhibit Button -------------------------- */

.script-exhibit-link {
  margin: 10px 0;
}

.script-exhibit-btn {
  font-family: "Courier New", Courier, monospace;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #0088FF;
  background: #0d0d1a;
  border: 2px solid #0088FF;
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 5px 14px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
  display: inline-block;
}

.script-exhibit-btn:hover {
  background: #0088FF;
  color: #0a0a0a;
}

/* -- Script Demo Callout ---------------------------- */

.script-demo-callout {
  background: #1a1a0d;
  border: 1px solid #CCAA33;
  border-left: 4px solid #CCAA33;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  margin: 8px 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #DDCC77;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.script-callout-label {
  font-weight: bold;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 1px 8px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  margin-right: 8px;
}

.script-demo-callout .script-callout-label {
  background: rgba(204, 170, 51, 0.2);
  color: #CCAA33;
}

/* -- Script Speaker Notes --------------------------- */

.script-speaker-label {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #666666;
  margin: 12px 0 4px 0;
}

.script-speech {
  background: #141414;
  border-left: 3px solid #0088FF;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  margin: 6px 0 8px 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-style: italic;
  color: #DDDDDD;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* -- Script Divider --------------------------------- */

.script-divider {
  border: none;
  border-top: 1px solid #333333;
  margin: 20px 0;
}

/* -- Progress Stats --------------------------------- */

#header-progress-stats {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  margin-right: 16px;
}

.progress-stat {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #999999;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.progress-stat-bar {
  width: 80px;
  height: 6px;
  background: #2a2a2a;
  border-radius: 3px;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: inline-block;
  vertical-align: middle;
  margin-left: 6px;
}

.progress-stat-fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 3px;
  transition: width 0.3s;
}

.progress-stat-fill-sections {
  background: #00CC55;
}

.progress-stat-fill-lectures {
  background: #CC44FF;
}

.progress-stat-fill-labs {
  background: #FFAA00;
}

/* -- START HERE Card -------------------------------- */

#start-here-card {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0d2a0d 0%, #1a1a1a 100%);
  border: 2px solid #00CC55;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 20px 24px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
}

#start-here-card:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0, 204, 85, 0.25);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

#start-here-icon {
  font-size: 32px;
  color: #00CC55;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(0, 204, 85, 0.15);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

#start-here-title {
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #00CC55;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
}

#start-here-subtitle {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #AAAAAA;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

#start-here-arrow {
  font-size: 24px;
  color: #00CC55;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-left: auto;
  animation: pulse-arrow 1.5s infinite;
}

@keyframes pulse-arrow {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.5; transform: translateX(0); }
  50% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(6px); }
}

/* -- Onboarding Modal ------------------------------- */

#onboarding-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  z-index: 4000;
  transition: opacity 0.2s;
}

#onboarding-overlay.onboarding-hidden {
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

#onboarding-overlay.onboarding-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

#onboarding-modal {
  background: #111111;
  border: 2px solid #00CC55;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 0;
  max-width: 560px;
  width: 92%;
  overflow: hidden;
}

#onboarding-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  background: #0a0a0a;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #333333;
}

#onboarding-step-label {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #00CC55;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

#onboarding-body {
  padding: 28px 24px 16px 24px;
  text-align: center;
  min-height: 140px;
}

#onboarding-body .ob-instruction {
  font-size: 18px;
  color: #EEEEEE;
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

#onboarding-body .ob-hint {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #888888;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

#onboarding-body .ob-arrow-down {
  font-size: 28px;
  color: #00CC55;
  animation: bounce-down 1s infinite;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

@keyframes bounce-down {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
  50% { transform: translateY(8px); }
}

#onboarding-launch-area {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 0 24px 16px 24px;
}

#onboarding-launch-btn {
  font-family: "Courier New", Courier, monospace;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #0a0a0a;
  background: #00CC55;
  border: 2px solid #00CC55;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 10px 28px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.15s;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

#onboarding-launch-btn:hover {
  background: #00FF66;
  border-color: #00FF66;
}

#onboarding-nav {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  background: #0a0a0a;
  border-top: 1px solid #333333;
}

#onboarding-dots {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
}

.ob-dot {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #333333;
  transition: background 0.2s;
}

.ob-dot.ob-dot-active {
  background: #00CC55;
}

.ob-dot.ob-dot-done {
  background: #006622;
}

/* -- Learning Paths Modal --------------------------- */

#paths-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  z-index: 4000;
  transition: opacity 0.2s;
}

#paths-overlay.paths-hidden {
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

#paths-overlay.paths-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

#paths-modal {
  background: #111111;
  border: 2px solid #0088FF;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 0;
  max-width: 720px;
  width: 92%;
  overflow: hidden;
}

#paths-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 14px 20px;
  background: #0a0a0a;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #333333;
}

#paths-title {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #0088FF;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

#paths-body {
  padding: 20px;
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  #paths-body {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
}

.path-card {
  flex: 1;
  background: #1a1a1a;
  border: 2px solid #333333;
  border-radius: 8px;

/* -- Academic Level Content Visibility -------------- */

/* By default, all level-content divs are hidden.
   JS adds a body/container class like level-show-200 to control visibility.
   Content without level markers is always visible (no .level-content class). */

.level-content {
  display: none;
}

/* When showing HS level: only hs content */
.level-show-hs .level-content.level-hs { display: block; }

/* When showing 100 level: hs + 100 */
.level-show-100 .level-content.level-hs,
.level-show-100 .level-content.level-100 { display: block; }

/* When showing 200 level: hs + 100 + 200 */
.level-show-200 .level-content.level-hs,
.level-show-200 .level-content.level-100,
.level-show-200 .level-content.level-200 { display: block; }

/* When showing 300 level: hs + 100 + 200 + 300 */
.level-show-300 .level-content.level-hs,
.level-show-300 .level-content.level-100,
.level-show-300 .level-content.level-200,
.level-show-300 .level-content.level-300 { display: block; }

/* When showing 400 level: hs + 100 + 200 + 300 + 400 */
.level-show-400 .level-content.level-hs,
.level-show-400 .level-content.level-100,
.level-show-400 .level-content.level-200,
.level-show-400 .level-content.level-300,
.level-show-400 .level-content.level-400 { display: block; }

/* When showing grad level: everything */
.level-show-grad .level-content.level-hs,
.level-show-grad .level-content.level-100,
.level-show-grad .level-content.level-200,
.level-show-grad .level-content.level-300,
.level-show-grad .level-content.level-400,
.level-show-grad .level-content.level-grad { display: block; }

/* Level indicator badges in the content */
.level-content.level-300::before,
.level-content.level-400::before,
.level-content.level-grad::before {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.level-content.level-300::before {
  content: "300-LEVEL";
  color: #FFAA00;
  background: rgba(255, 170, 0, 0.1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 170, 0, 0.3);
}

.level-content.level-400::before {
  content: "400-LEVEL";
  color: #FF6644;
  background: rgba(255, 102, 68, 0.1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 102, 68, 0.3);
}

.level-content.level-grad::before {
  content: "GRADUATE";
  color: #CC44FF;
  background: rgba(204, 68, 255, 0.1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(204, 68, 255, 0.3);
}

  // -- Progress Stats Display -------------------------

  function countLecturesViewed() {

    for (key in lecturesViewed) {

    }
    return count;

    for (key in quizzesCompleted) {

        count++;

  function countTotalLabs() {

          count++;

  // Build reverse map: exhibitId -> labId (for card button rendering)
  function getLabIdForExhibit(exhibitId) {
    var key;

      return null;

    for (key in LAB_MAP) {
      if (LAB_MAP.hasOwnProperty(key) && LAB_MAP[key] === exhibitId) {
        return key;

  function updateProgressStats() {
    var container = document.getElementById("header-progress-stats");
    if (!container) {
      return;
    }
    container.innerHTML = "";

    var sectionCount = countViewed();
    var lectureCount = countLecturesViewed();
    var quizCount = countQuizzesCompleted();
    var totalSections = SECTIONS.length;
    var totalQuizzable = countQuizzablesSections();

    // Section progress
    var secStat = document.createElement("div");
    secStat.className = "progress-stat";

      + '<div class="progress-stat-bar"><div class="progress-stat-fill progress-stat-fill-sections" style="width:' + secPct + '%"></div></div>';

      var labPct = Math.round((labCount / totalLabs) * 100);

  // -- Toast ------------------------------------------

    toastTimer = setTimeout(function() {

  // -- Achievement System -----------------------------
  function loadAchievements() {
    try {
      var raw = localStorage.getItem(ACHIEVEMENTS_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (raw) {
        var data = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (data) {
          earnedAchievements = data;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      earnedAchievements = {};
    }
  }

  function saveAchievements() {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(ACHIEVEMENTS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(earnedAchievements));
    } catch (e) {
      // storage unavailable
    }
  }

  function buildProgressSnapshot() {
    var snapshot = {};
    snapshot.sectionsViewed = countViewed();
    snapshot.totalSections = SECTIONS.length;
    snapshot.lecturesRead = countLecturesViewed();
    snapshot.quizzesCompleted = countQuizzesCompleted();
    snapshot.totalQuizzes = countQuizzablesSections();
    snapshot.labsCompleted = countLabsViewed();
    snapshot.totalLabs = countTotalLabs();

    // Compute quiz average
    var totalScore = 0;
    var totalQuestions = 0;
    var key;
    for (key in quizScores) {
      if (quizScores.hasOwnProperty(key) && quizScores[key]) {
        totalScore += quizScores[key].score;
        totalQuestions += quizScores[key].total;
      }
    }
    snapshot.quizAverage = (totalQuestions > 0) ? Math.round((totalScore / totalQuestions) * 100) : 0;

    // Check if any learning path is complete
    snapshot.pathCompleted = false;
    var p, path, allViewed, s;
    for (p = 0; p < LEARNING_PATHS.length; p++) {
      path = LEARNING_PATHS[p];
      allViewed = true;
      for (s = 0; s < path.sectionIds.length; s++) {
        var sec = getSectionById(path.sectionIds[s]);
        if (sec && !viewed[sec.key]) {
          allViewed = false;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (allViewed && path.sectionIds.length > 0) {
        snapshot.pathCompleted = true;
        break;
      }
    }

    return snapshot;
  }

  function checkAchievements() {
    if (typeof ACHIEVEMENTS === "undefined" || !ACHIEVEMENTS.length) {
      return;
    }

    var snapshot = buildProgressSnapshot();
    var i, achievement;
    for (i = 0; i < ACHIEVEMENTS.length; i++) {
      achievement = ACHIEVEMENTS[i];
      if (!earnedAchievements[achievement.id] && achievement.check(snapshot)) {
        earnedAchievements[achievement.id] = true;
        saveAchievements();
        showAchievementToast(achievement);
      }
    }
  }

    var html = '<div class="level-toggle-bar">';

    var k;
    for (k = 0; k < LEVEL_KEYS.length; k++) {
      var key = LEVEL_KEYS[k];
      var activeClass = (key === currentLevel) ? " level-active" : "";
      html += '<button class="level-toggle-btn' + activeClass + '" data-level="' + key + '">'
        + LEVEL_LABELS[key] + '</button>';
    }
    html += '</div>';
    return html;
  }

  function applyLevelVisibility(containerEl, level) {
    // Remove all existing level-show-* classes
    var k;
    for (k = 0; k < LEVEL_KEYS.length; k++) {
      containerEl.classList.remove("level-show-" + LEVEL_KEYS[k]);
    }
    // Add the selected level class
    containerEl.classList.add("level-show-" + level);
  }

  function wireUpLevelToggle(contentEl) {
    var buttons = contentEl.querySelectorAll(".level-toggle-btn");
    var b;
    for (b = 0; b < buttons.length; b++) {
      (function(btn) {
        btn.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          var level = btn.getAttribute("data-level");
          setSelectedLevel(level);
          // Update active state on all toggle buttons
          var allBtns = contentEl.querySelectorAll(".level-toggle-btn");
          var j;
          for (j = 0; j < allBtns.length; j++) {
            if (allBtns[j].getAttribute("data-level") === level) {
              allBtns[j].className = "level-toggle-btn level-active";
            } else {
              allBtns[j].className = "level-toggle-btn";
            }
          }
          // Apply visibility
          applyLevelVisibility(contentEl, level);
        });
      })(buttons[b]);
    }
  }

  function showLecture(exhibitId) {
    if (typeof LECTURE_BUNDLES === "undefined" || !LECTURE_BUNDLES[exhibitId]) {
      showToast("No lecture found for " + exhibitId);

    // Track lecture visit
    lecturesViewed[exhibitId] = true;

    updateProgressStats();
    checkAchievements();

    var panel = document.getElementById("script-panel");
    var contentEl = document.getElementById("script-content");
    var titleEl = document.getElementById("script-title");
    if (!panel || !contentEl) {
      return;

    var lectureHtml;
    try {
      lectureHtml = decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(LECTURE_BUNDLES[exhibitId])));

      contentEl.innerHTML = "<p>Error decoding lecture content.</p>";
      panel.className = "script-visible";
      document.body.className = "script-open";
      scriptVisible = true;
      lectureActive = true;
      return;

      + '<button class="script-exhibit-btn" style="border-color:#CC44FF;color:#CC44FF;" '
      + 'onclick="window._backToMainScript()">← Back to Script</button>'
      + '</div>';
    var levelBar = buildLevelToggleHtml(currentLevel);
    contentEl.innerHTML = backBtn + levelBar + processGlossaryLinks(lectureHtml);

    // Apply level visibility to the content container
    applyLevelVisibility(contentEl, currentLevel);

    // Wire up level toggle buttons
    wireUpLevelToggle(contentEl);

    if (titleEl) { titleEl.textContent = "Lecture"; }
    panel.className = "script-visible";
    document.body.className = "script-open";
    scriptVisible = true;
    lectureActive = true;
    contentEl.scrollTop = 0;

  // -- Quiz System ------------------------------------
  function showQuiz(exhibitId) {
    if (typeof QUIZ_DATA === "undefined" || !QUIZ_DATA[exhibitId]) {
      showToast("No quiz found for " + exhibitId);
      return;
    }

    var questions = QUIZ_DATA[exhibitId];
    var currentQ = 0;
    var score = 0;
    var answered = [];
    var missed = [];
    var i;
    for (i = 0; i < questions.length; i++) {
      answered.push(false);
    }

    var panel = document.getElementById("script-panel");
    var contentEl = document.getElementById("script-content");
    var titleEl = document.getElementById("script-title");
    if (!panel || !contentEl) {
      return;
    }

    if (titleEl) { titleEl.textContent = "Quiz"; }
    quizActive = true;

    function renderQuestion() {
      var q = questions[currentQ];
      var html = '<div class="quiz-container">';

      // Back button
      html += '<div style="margin-bottom:16px;">';
      html += '<button class="script-exhibit-btn" style="border-color:#CC44FF;color:#CC44FF;" id="quiz-back-to-script">← Back to Script</button>';
      html += '</div>';

      // Header
      html += '<div class="quiz-header">Quiz</div>';
      html += '<div class="quiz-progress-text">Question ' + (currentQ + 1) + ' of ' + questions.length + ' — Score: ' + score + '/' + questions.length + '</div>';

      // Score bar
      var pct = (questions.length > 0) ? Math.round((score / questions.length) * 100) : 0;
      html += '<div class="quiz-score-bar"><div class="quiz-score-fill" style="width:' + pct + '%"></div></div>';

      // Question card
      html += '<div class="quiz-question-card">';
      html += '<div class="quiz-question-num">Question ' + (currentQ + 1) + '</div>';
      html += '<div class="quiz-question-text">' + q.q + '</div>';

      // Options
      html += '<div class="quiz-options">';
      var keys = ["a", "b", "c", "d"];
      var k;
      for (k = 0; k < keys.length; k++) {
        html += '<button class="quiz-option-btn" data-key="' + keys[k] + '">';
        html += '<strong>' + keys[k].toUpperCase() + '.</strong> ' + q.opts[keys[k]];
        html += '</button>';
      }
      html += '</div>';

      // Feedback
      html += '<div class="quiz-feedback" id="quiz-feedback"></div>';

      // Next button
      html += '<button class="quiz-next-btn" id="quiz-next">Next →</button>';

      html += '</div>'; // end question card
      html += '</div>'; // end container

      contentEl.innerHTML = html;
      contentEl.scrollTop = 0;

      // Wire up back button
      var backBtn = document.getElementById("quiz-back-to-script");
      if (backBtn) {
        backBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
          quizActive = false;
          scriptLoaded = false;
          if (titleEl) { titleEl.textContent = "Script"; }
          showScript();
        });
      }

      // Wire up option buttons
      var optBtns = contentEl.querySelectorAll(".quiz-option-btn");
      var b;
      for (b = 0; b < optBtns.length; b++) {
        (function(btn) {
          btn.addEventListener("click", function() {
            if (answered[currentQ]) {
              return;
            }
            onAnswer(btn.getAttribute("data-key"));
          });
        })(optBtns[b]);
      }

      // Wire up next button
      var nextBtn = document.getElementById("quiz-next");
      if (nextBtn) {
        nextBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
          if (currentQ < questions.length - 1) {
            currentQ++;
            renderQuestion();
          } else {
            renderResults();
          }
        });
      }
    }

    function onAnswer(chosen) {
      var q = questions[currentQ];
      answered[currentQ] = true;
      var isCorrect = (chosen === q.ans);

      if (isCorrect) {
        score++;
      } else {
        missed.push({
          idx: currentQ,
          question: q.q,
          yourAnswer: q.opts[chosen],
          correctAnswer: q.opts[q.ans],
          explanation: q.expl
        });
      }

      // Style all option buttons
      var optBtns = contentEl.querySelectorAll(".quiz-option-btn");
      var b;
      for (b = 0; b < optBtns.length; b++) {
        var key = optBtns[b].getAttribute("data-key");
        if (key === q.ans) {
          optBtns[b].className = "quiz-option-btn quiz-option-correct";
        } else if (key === chosen && !isCorrect) {
          optBtns[b].className = "quiz-option-btn quiz-option-wrong";
        } else {
          optBtns[b].className = "quiz-option-btn quiz-option-disabled";
        }
      }

      // Show feedback
      var feedbackEl = document.getElementById("quiz-feedback");
      if (feedbackEl) {
        if (isCorrect) {
          feedbackEl.className = "quiz-feedback quiz-feedback-correct";
          feedbackEl.innerHTML = "<strong>Correct!</strong> " + q.expl;
        } else {
          feedbackEl.className = "quiz-feedback quiz-feedback-wrong";
          feedbackEl.innerHTML = "<strong>Incorrect.</strong> " + q.expl;
        }
      }

      // Show next button
      var nextBtn = document.getElementById("quiz-next");
      if (nextBtn) {
        if (currentQ < questions.length - 1) {
          nextBtn.textContent = "Next \u2192";
        } else {
          nextBtn.textContent = "See Results";
        }
        nextBtn.className = "quiz-next-btn quiz-next-visible";
      }

      // Update score bar
      var fillEl = contentEl.querySelector(".quiz-score-fill");
      if (fillEl) {
        var pct = Math.round((score / questions.length) * 100);
        fillEl.style.width = pct + "%";
      }

      // Update progress text
      var progEl = contentEl.querySelector(".quiz-progress-text");
      if (progEl) {
        progEl.innerHTML = "Question " + (currentQ + 1) + " of " + questions.length + " — Score: " + score + "/" + questions.length;
      }
    }

    function renderResults() {
      quizzesCompleted[exhibitId] = true;
      quizScores[exhibitId] = { score: score, total: questions.length };
      saveProgress();
      updateProgressStats();
      checkAchievements();
      renderGrid();

      var pct = Math.round((score / questions.length) * 100);
      var gradeText = "";
      var gradeClass = "";
      if (pct === 100) {
        gradeText = "PERFECT SCORE";
        gradeClass = "quiz-results-grade-perfect";
      } else if (pct >= 80) {
        gradeText = "GREAT JOB";
        gradeClass = "quiz-results-grade-great";
      } else if (pct >= 60) {
        gradeText = "GOOD EFFORT";
        gradeClass = "quiz-results-grade-good";
      } else {
        gradeText = "NEEDS REVIEW";
        gradeClass = "quiz-results-grade-needs-work";
      }

      var html = '<div class="quiz-container">';

      // Back button
      html += '<div style="margin-bottom:16px;">';
      html += '<button class="script-exhibit-btn" style="border-color:#CC44FF;color:#CC44FF;" id="quiz-results-back">← Back to Script</button>';
      html += '</div>';

      html += '<div class="quiz-results">';
      html += '<div class="quiz-results-title">Quiz Complete</div>';
      html += '<div class="quiz-results-score">' + score + ' / ' + questions.length + '</div>';
      html += '<div class="quiz-results-pct">' + pct + '%</div>';
      html += '<div class="quiz-results-grade ' + gradeClass + '">' + gradeText + '</div>';

      // Missed questions
      if (missed.length > 0) {
        html += '<div class="quiz-missed-header">Missed Questions (' + missed.length + ')</div>';
        var m;
        for (m = 0; m < missed.length; m++) {
          html += '<div class="quiz-missed-item">';
          html += '<div class="quiz-missed-q">Q' + (missed[m].idx + 1) + ': ' + missed[m].question + '</div>';
          html += '<div class="quiz-missed-answer">Correct: ' + missed[m].correctAnswer + '</div>';
          html += '</div>';
        }
      }

      // Actions
      html += '<div class="quiz-results-actions">';
      html += '<button class="quiz-retry-btn" id="quiz-retry">Retry Quiz</button>';
      html += '<button class="quiz-back-btn" id="quiz-done">Back to Hub</button>';
      html += '</div>';

      html += '</div>'; // end results
      html += '</div>'; // end container

      contentEl.innerHTML = html;
      contentEl.scrollTop = 0;

      // Wire back button
      var backBtn = document.getElementById("quiz-results-back");
      if (backBtn) {
        backBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
          quizActive = false;
          scriptLoaded = false;
          if (titleEl) { titleEl.textContent = "Script"; }
          showScript();
        });
      }

      // Wire retry
      var retryBtn = document.getElementById("quiz-retry");
      if (retryBtn) {
        retryBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
          showQuiz(exhibitId);
        });
      }

      // Wire done
      var doneBtn = document.getElementById("quiz-done");
      if (doneBtn) {
        doneBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
          quizActive = false;
          hideScript();
        });
      }
    }

    // Open the script panel and show the quiz
    panel.className = "script-visible";
    document.body.className = "script-open";
    scriptVisible = true;
    saveProgress();

    renderQuestion();
  }

  window.showQuiz = showQuiz;

  // -- Learning Path Helpers --------------------------
  function getSectionIdsInPath() {
    if (!activePath) {
      return null;
    }
    return activePath.sectionIds;
  }

  function isSectionInPath(sectionId) {
    var ids = getSectionIdsInPath();
    if (!ids) {
      return true;
    }
    var j;
    for (j = 0; j < ids.length; j++) {
      if (ids[j] === sectionId) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  function getPathOrder(sectionId) {
    var ids = getSectionIdsInPath();
    if (!ids) {
      return -1;
    }
    var j;
    for (j = 0; j < ids.length; j++) {
      if (ids[j] === sectionId) {
        return j + 1;
      }
    }
    return -1;
  }

  // -- Render Grid ------------------------------------
  function renderGrid() {
    var container = document.getElementById("section-grid");
    if (!container) {
      return;
    }
    container.innerHTML = "";

    var i, sec, card, topRow, numEl, checkEl, titleEl, descEl, bottomRow, timeEl;
    var currentTier = "";

    for (i = 0; i < SECTIONS.length; i++) {
      sec = SECTIONS[i];

      // Insert tier header when tier changes
      if (sec.tier !== currentTier) {
        currentTier = sec.tier;
        var tierHeader = document.createElement("div");
        tierHeader.className = "tier-header";
        tierHeader.textContent = currentTier;
        tierHeader.style.color = TIER_COLORS[currentTier] || "#EEEEEE";
        tierHeader.style.borderBottomColor = TIER_COLORS[currentTier] || "#333333";
        container.appendChild(tierHeader);
      }

      card = document.createElement("div");
      card.className = "section-card";
      if (i === currentIndex) {
        card.className += " active";
      }

      // Learning path highlight/dim
      if (activePath) {
        if (isSectionInPath(sec.id)) {
          card.className += " path-highlighted";
        } else {
          card.className += " path-dimmed";
        }
      }

      card.style.borderLeftColor = sec.color;
      card.style.borderLeftWidth = "4px";
      card.style.borderLeftStyle = "solid";
      card.setAttribute("data-index", String(i));

      // Hover glow (only if not dimmed) + card tooltip
      (function(c, color, section) {
        c.addEventListener("mouseover", function() {
          if (c.className.indexOf("path-dimmed") === -1) {
            c.style.boxShadow = "0 4px 16px " + color + "33";
          }
          if (cardTooltipTimer) { clearTimeout(cardTooltipTimer); }
          cardTooltipTimer = setTimeout(function() {
            showCardTooltip(section, c);
          }, 400);
        });
        c.addEventListener("mouseout", function() {
          c.style.boxShadow = "none";
          if (cardTooltipTimer) { clearTimeout(cardTooltipTimer); cardTooltipTimer = null; }
          hideCardTooltip();
        });
      })(card, sec.color, sec);

      // Click
      (function(idx) {
        card.addEventListener("click", function() {
          onCardClick(idx);
        });
      })(i);

      // Top row: number + checkmark
      topRow = document.createElement("div");
      topRow.className = "card-top-row";

      numEl = document.createElement("div");
      numEl.className = "card-number";
      numEl.style.color = sec.color;
      numEl.textContent = String(sec.id);

      checkEl = document.createElement("div");
      checkEl.className = "card-check";
      if (viewed[sec.key]) {
        checkEl.className += " viewed";
        checkEl.textContent = "\u2713";
      } else {
        checkEl.innerHTML = "";
      }

      topRow.appendChild(numEl);
      topRow.appendChild(checkEl);
      card.appendChild(topRow);

      // Path order badge
      if (activePath) {
        var pathOrder = getPathOrder(sec.id);
        if (pathOrder > 0) {
          var badge = document.createElement("div");
          badge.className = "path-order-badge";
          badge.textContent = String(pathOrder);
          card.appendChild(badge);
        }
      }

      // Title
      titleEl = document.createElement("div");
      titleEl.className = "card-title";
      titleEl.textContent = sec.title;
      card.appendChild(titleEl);

      // Description
      descEl = document.createElement("div");
      descEl.className = "card-desc";
      descEl.textContent = sec.desc;
      card.appendChild(descEl);

      // Bottom row: time badge + complexity + availability
      bottomRow = document.createElement("div");
      bottomRow.className = "card-bottom-row";

      timeEl = document.createElement("div");
      timeEl.className = "card-time";
      timeEl.textContent = "~" + sec.time + " min";

      var complexityEl = document.createElement("div");
      complexityEl.className = "card-complexity";
      complexityEl.textContent = sec.complexity;
      complexityEl.style.color = COMPLEXITY_COLORS[sec.complexity] || "#999999";
      complexityEl.style.background = "rgba(0,0,0,0.3)";
      complexityEl.style.border = "1px solid " + (COMPLEXITY_COLORS[sec.complexity] || "#555555") + "44";

      var statusEl = document.createElement("div");
      if (isAvailable(sec)) {
        statusEl.className = "card-status card-status-ready";
        statusEl.textContent = "READY";
      } else {
        statusEl.className = "card-status card-status-pending";
        statusEl.textContent = "PENDING";
      }

      // Lecture button (only if lecture exists)
      var lectureBtn = null;
      if (typeof LECTURE_BUNDLES !== "undefined" && LECTURE_BUNDLES[sec.exhibitId]) {
        lectureBtn = document.createElement("button");
        lectureBtn.className = "card-lecture-btn";
        lectureBtn.innerHTML = "📖 Lecture";
        lectureBtn.setAttribute("data-exhibit", sec.exhibitId);
        (function(eid) {
          lectureBtn.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            showLecture(eid);
          });
        })(sec.exhibitId);
      }

      // Quiz button (only if quiz data exists)
      var quizBtn = null;
      if (typeof QUIZ_DATA !== "undefined" && QUIZ_DATA[sec.exhibitId]) {
        quizBtn = document.createElement("button");
        if (quizzesCompleted[sec.exhibitId]) {
          quizBtn.className = "card-quiz-btn card-quiz-btn-done";
          var savedScore = quizScores[sec.exhibitId];
          if (savedScore) {
            quizBtn.textContent = "Quiz " + savedScore.score + "/" + savedScore.total;
          } else {
            quizBtn.textContent = "Quiz \u2713";
          }
        } else {
          quizBtn.className = "card-quiz-btn";
          quizBtn.textContent = "Quiz";
        }
        quizBtn.setAttribute("data-exhibit", sec.exhibitId);
        (function(eid) {
          quizBtn.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            showQuiz(eid);
          });
        })(sec.exhibitId);
      }

      // Lab button (only if lab exists for this section)
      var labBtn = null;
      var labId = getLabIdForExhibit(sec.exhibitId);
      if (labId && typeof LAB_BUNDLES !== "undefined" && LAB_BUNDLES[labId]) {
        labBtn = document.createElement("button");
        if (labsViewed[labId]) {
          labBtn.className = "card-lab-btn card-lab-btn-done";
          labBtn.innerHTML = "🧪 Lab ✓";
        } else {
          labBtn.className = "card-lab-btn";
          labBtn.innerHTML = "🧪 Lab";
        }
        labBtn.setAttribute("data-lab", labId);
        (function(lid) {
          labBtn.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            showLab(lid);
          });
        })(labId);
      }

      bottomRow.appendChild(timeEl);
      bottomRow.appendChild(complexityEl);
      if (lectureBtn) {
        bottomRow.appendChild(lectureBtn);
      }
      if (labBtn) {
        bottomRow.appendChild(labBtn);
      }
      if (quizBtn) {
        bottomRow.appendChild(quizBtn);
      }
      bottomRow.appendChild(statusEl);
      card.appendChild(bottomRow);

      container.appendChild(card);
    }
  }

      renderGrid();
      updateToolbar();
      scrollToCard(currentIndex);

      renderGrid();
      updateToolbar();
      scrollToCard(currentIndex);
    }

      updateToolbar();

  function renderOnboardingStep() {
    var step = ONBOARDING_STEPS[onboardingStep];
    var label = document.getElementById("onboarding-step-label");
    var body = document.getElementById("onboarding-body");
    var launchArea = document.getElementById("onboarding-launch-area");
    var prevBtn = document.getElementById("onboarding-prev");
    var nextBtn = document.getElementById("onboarding-next");
    var dotsEl = document.getElementById("onboarding-dots");

    if (label) {
      label.textContent = "Step " + (onboardingStep + 1) + " of " + ONBOARDING_STEPS.length;
    }

    if (body) {
      var html = '<div class="ob-instruction">' + step.instruction + '</div>';
      html += '<div class="ob-hint">' + step.hint + '</div>';
      if (step.arrow) {
        html += '<div class="ob-arrow-down">\u2193</div>';
      }
      body.innerHTML = html;
    }

    if (launchArea) {
      if (step.showLaunch) {
        var sslExhibitId = "exhibit-ssl-s1-interface";
        var hasEmbed = (typeof EXHIBIT_BUNDLES !== "undefined" && EXHIBIT_BUNDLES[sslExhibitId]);
        if (hasEmbed) {
          launchArea.innerHTML = '<button id="onboarding-launch-btn">Launch SuperSynthLab</button>';
          var launchBtn = document.getElementById("onboarding-launch-btn");
          if (launchBtn) {
            launchBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
              var sec = null;
              var k;
              for (k = 0; k < SECTIONS.length; k++) {
                if (SECTIONS[k].exhibitId === sslExhibitId) {
                  sec = SECTIONS[k];
                  break;
                }
              }
              if (sec) {
                showEmbeddedExhibit(sec);
              }
            });
          }
        } else {
          launchArea.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#888;">SuperSynthLab will open in the sidebar. Look for exhibit-ssl-s1-interface.</div>';
        }
      } else {
        launchArea.innerHTML = "";
      }
    }

    if (prevBtn) {
      prevBtn.disabled = (onboardingStep <= 0);
    }

  // -- Glossary Cross-Linking --------------------------

  var glossaryTermIndex = null;

  function buildGlossaryIndex() {
    if (glossaryTermIndex) {
      return;
    }
    if (typeof HUB_GLOSSARY_TERMS === "undefined" || !HUB_GLOSSARY_TERMS.length) {
      glossaryTermIndex = [];
      return;
    }
    // Sort by term length descending so longer terms match first
    var sorted = HUB_GLOSSARY_TERMS.slice(0);
    sorted.sort(function(a, b) {
      return b.term.length - a.term.length;
    });
    glossaryTermIndex = sorted;
  }

  function processGlossaryLinks(html) {
    buildGlossaryIndex();
    if (!glossaryTermIndex || !glossaryTermIndex.length) {
      return html;
    }

    // Parse the HTML into a temporary container
    var container = document.createElement("div");
    container.innerHTML = html;

    var linked = {};
    var maxLinks = 80;
    var linkCount = 0;

    // Walk text nodes, skip headings/code/links/buttons
    function shouldSkip(node) {
      var tag = node.nodeName.toUpperCase();
      if (tag === "H1" || tag === "H2" || tag === "H3" || tag === "H4" || tag === "H5" || tag === "H6") {
        return true;
      }
      if (tag === "A" || tag === "BUTTON" || tag === "CODE" || tag === "PRE" || tag === "SCRIPT") {
        return true;
      }
      if (node.className && typeof node.className === "string") {
        if (node.className.indexOf("glossary-link") !== -1) {
          return true;
        }
        if (node.className.indexOf("script-section-header") !== -1 || node.className.indexOf("script-subsection-header") !== -1) {
          return true;
        }
      }
      return false;
    }

    function walkNode(node) {
      if (linkCount >= maxLinks) {
        return;
      }
      if (node.nodeType === 1) {
        if (shouldSkip(node)) {
          return;
        }
        // Process child nodes (copy to array since we may modify children)
        var children = [];
        var c;
        for (c = 0; c < node.childNodes.length; c++) {
          children.push(node.childNodes[c]);
        }
        var i;
        for (i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
          walkNode(children[i]);
        }
      } else if (node.nodeType === 3) {
        // Text node
        var text = node.nodeValue;
        if (!text || text.trim().length < 2) {
          return;
        }

        var t;
        for (t = 0; t < glossaryTermIndex.length; t++) {
          if (linkCount >= maxLinks) {
            break;
          }
          var entry = glossaryTermIndex[t];
          if (linked[entry.term]) {
            continue;
          }

          // Build a word-boundary regex for this term
          var escaped = entry.term.replace(/([.*+?^${}()|[\]\\])/g, "\\$1");
          var re = new RegExp("\\b" + escaped + "\\b", "i");
          var match = re.exec(node.nodeValue);
          if (match) {
            // Split text node at the match
            var before = node.nodeValue.substring(0, match.index);
            var matched = node.nodeValue.substring(match.index, match.index + match[0].length);
            var after = node.nodeValue.substring(match.index + match[0].length);

            var span = document.createElement("span");
            span.className = "glossary-link";
            span.setAttribute("data-glossary-term", entry.term);
            span.textContent = matched;

            var parent = node.parentNode;
            if (before) {
              parent.insertBefore(document.createTextNode(before), node);
            }
            parent.insertBefore(span, node);
            if (after) {
              var afterNode = document.createTextNode(after);
              parent.insertBefore(afterNode, node);
              // Continue searching in the after text node (for other terms)
              node.nodeValue = "";
              parent.removeChild(node);
              node = afterNode;
            } else {
              parent.removeChild(node);
            }

            linked[entry.term] = true;
            linkCount++;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    walkNode(container);
    return container.innerHTML;
  }

        }
        e.preventDefault();
      } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
        hideABOverlay();
        e.preventDefault();
      }
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "Right") {
      goNext();
      e.preventDefault();
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "Left") {
      goPrev();
      e.preventDefault();
    } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
      if (tourActive) {
        hideGuidedTour();
        e.preventDefault();
      } else if (document.getElementById("achievements-overlay") &&
          document.getElementById("achievements-overlay").className === "achievements-visible") {
        hideAchievementsModal();
        e.preventDefault();
      } else if (document.getElementById("help-overlay") &&
          document.getElementById("help-overlay").className === "help-visible") {
        hideHelpModal();
        e.preventDefault();
      } else if (isABModalVisible()) {
        hideABModal();
        e.preventDefault();
      } else if (document.getElementById("onboarding-overlay") &&
          document.getElementById("onboarding-overlay").className === "onboarding-visible") {
        hideOnboarding();
        e.preventDefault();
      } else if (document.getElementById("paths-overlay") &&
          document.getElementById("paths-overlay").className === "paths-visible") {
        hidePathsModal();
        e.preventDefault();
      } else if (document.getElementById("embed-overlay") &&
          document.getElementById("embed-overlay").className === "embed-visible") {
        hideEmbed();
        e.preventDefault();
      } else {
        hideModal();
        e.preventDefault();
      }
    } else if (e.key === "s" || e.key === "S") {
      toggleScript();
      e.preventDefault();
    } else if (e.key >= "1" && e.key <= "9") {
      goToSection(parseInt(e.key, 10));
      e.preventDefault();
    }
  }

  // -- Init -------------------------------------------
  function init() {
    displayVersion();
    loadProgress();
    loadAchievements();
    renderGrid();
    updateToolbar();
    updateProgressStats();

    var prevBtn = document.getElementById("btn-prev");
    var nextBtn = document.getElementById("btn-next");
    var resetBtn = document.getElementById("btn-reset");

    if (prevBtn) {
      prevBtn.addEventListener("click", goPrev);
    }
    if (nextBtn) {
      nextBtn.addEventListener("click", goNext);
    }
    if (resetBtn) {
      resetBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
        if (confirm("Reset all progress?")) {
          resetProgress();
        }
      });
    }

    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);

    var scriptBtn = document.getElementById("btn-script");
    if (scriptBtn) {
      scriptBtn.addEventListener("click", toggleScript);
    }

    var scriptCloseBtn = document.getElementById("script-close");
    if (scriptCloseBtn) {
      scriptCloseBtn.addEventListener("click", hideScript);
    }

    var embedCloseBtn = document.getElementById("embed-close");
    if (embedCloseBtn) {
      embedCloseBtn.addEventListener("click", hideEmbed);
    }

    // Detect when iframe steals focus
    setInterval(function() {
      var embedOverlay = document.getElementById("embed-overlay");
      if (embedOverlay && embedOverlay.className === "embed-visible") {
        if (document.activeElement && document.activeElement.tagName === "IFRAME") {
          if (embedCloseBtn) {
            embedCloseBtn.style.boxShadow = "0 0 8px #FF5555";
          }
        } else {
          if (embedCloseBtn) {
            embedCloseBtn.style.boxShadow = "none";
          }
        }
      }
    }, 500);

    var modalOverlay = document.getElementById("modal-overlay");
    var modalCloseBtn = document.getElementById("modal-close");
    if (modalCloseBtn) {
      modalCloseBtn.addEventListener("click", hideModal);
    }
    if (modalOverlay) {
      modalOverlay.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
        if (e.target === modalOverlay) {
          hideModal();
        }
      });
    }

    // -- START HERE card --------------------------------
    var startHereCard = document.getElementById("start-here-card");
    if (startHereCard) {
      startHereCard.addEventListener("click", showOnboarding);
    }

    // -- Onboarding controls ----------------------------
    var obCloseBtn = document.getElementById("onboarding-close");
    var obPrevBtn = document.getElementById("onboarding-prev");
    var obNextBtn = document.getElementById("onboarding-next");
    var obOverlay = document.getElementById("onboarding-overlay");

    if (obCloseBtn) {
      obCloseBtn.addEventListener("click", hideOnboarding);
    }
    if (obPrevBtn) {
      obPrevBtn.addEventListener("click", onboardingPrev);
    }
    if (obNextBtn) {
      obNextBtn.addEventListener("click", onboardingNext);
    }
    if (obOverlay) {
      obOverlay.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
        if (e.target === obOverlay) {
          hideOnboarding();
        }
      });
    }

    // -- Learning Paths controls ------------------------
    var pathsBtn = document.getElementById("btn-paths");
    var clearPathBtn = document.getElementById("btn-clear-path");
    var pathsCloseBtn = document.getElementById("paths-close");
    var pathsOverlay = document.getElementById("paths-overlay");

    if (pathsBtn) {
      pathsBtn.addEventListener("click", showPathsModal);
    }
    if (clearPathBtn) {
      clearPathBtn.addEventListener("click", clearActivePath);
    }
    if (pathsCloseBtn) {
      pathsCloseBtn.addEventListener("click", hidePathsModal);
    }
    if (pathsOverlay) {
      pathsOverlay.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
        if (e.target === pathsOverlay) {
          hidePathsModal();
        }
      });
    }

    // -- A/B Compare controls ----------------------------
    var abBtn = document.getElementById("btn-ab");
    if (abBtn) {
      abBtn.addEventListener("click", showABCompare);
    }

    var abModalCloseBtn = document.getElementById("ab-modal-close");
    if (abModalCloseBtn) {
      abModalCloseBtn.addEventListener("click", hideABModal);
    }

    var abModalOverlay = document.getElementById("ab-modal-overlay");
    if (abModalOverlay) {
      abModalOverlay.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
        if (e.target === abModalOverlay) {
          hideABModal();
        }
      });
    }

    var abLoadABtn = document.getElementById("ab-load-a");
    if (abLoadABtn) {
      abLoadABtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
        loadABPanel("a");
      });
    }

    var abLoadBBtn = document.getElementById("ab-load-b");
    if (abLoadBBtn) {
      abLoadBBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
        loadABPanel("b");
      });
    }

    var abLaunchBtn = document.getElementById("ab-launch");
    if (abLaunchBtn) {
      abLaunchBtn.addEventListener("click", launchABCompare);
    }

    var abCloseBtn = document.getElementById("ab-close");
    if (abCloseBtn) {
      abCloseBtn.addEventListener("click", hideABOverlay);
    }

    var abToggleA = document.getElementById("ab-toggle-a");
    if (abToggleA) {
      abToggleA.addEventListener("click", function() {
        setABMode("a");
      });
    }

    var abToggleB = document.getElementById("ab-toggle-b");
    if (abToggleB) {
      abToggleB.addEventListener("click", function() {
        setABMode("b");
      });
    }

    var abSplitBtn = document.getElementById("ab-split");
    if (abSplitBtn) {
      abSplitBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
        if (abMode === "split") {
          setABMode("a");
        } else {
          setABMode("split");
        }
      });
    }

    // -- Guided Tour controls ----------------------------
    var tourBtn = document.getElementById("btn-guided-tour");
    if (tourBtn) {
      tourBtn.addEventListener("click", showGuidedTour);
    }

    var tourNextBtn = document.getElementById("tour-next");
    if (tourNextBtn) {
      tourNextBtn.addEventListener("click", tourNext);
    }

    var tourBackBtn = document.getElementById("tour-back");
    if (tourBackBtn) {
      tourBackBtn.addEventListener("click", tourBack);
    }

    var tourSkipBtn = document.getElementById("tour-skip");
    if (tourSkipBtn) {
      tourSkipBtn.addEventListener("click", hideGuidedTour);
    }

    var tourOverlay = document.getElementById("tour-overlay");
    if (tourOverlay) {
      tourOverlay.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
        if (e.target === tourOverlay) {
          hideGuidedTour();
        }
      });
    }

    // -- Help controls -----------------------------------
    var helpBtn = document.getElementById("btn-help");
    if (helpBtn) {
      helpBtn.addEventListener("click", showHelpModal);
    }

    var helpCloseBtn = document.getElementById("help-close");
    if (helpCloseBtn) {
      helpCloseBtn.addEventListener("click", hideHelpModal);
    }

    var helpOverlay = document.getElementById("help-overlay");
    if (helpOverlay) {
      helpOverlay.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
        if (e.target === helpOverlay) {
          hideHelpModal();
        }
      });
    }

    // -- Achievement controls -----------------------------
    var achievementsBtn = document.getElementById("btn-achievements");
    if (achievementsBtn) {
      achievementsBtn.addEventListener("click", showAchievementsModal);
    }

    var achievementsCloseBtn = document.getElementById("achievements-close");
    if (achievementsCloseBtn) {
      achievementsCloseBtn.addEventListener("click", hideAchievementsModal);
    }

    var achievementsOverlay = document.getElementById("achievements-overlay");
    if (achievementsOverlay) {
      achievementsOverlay.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
        if (e.target === achievementsOverlay) {
          hideAchievementsModal();
        }
      });
    }

    // -- Glossary cross-link events ----------------------
    initGlossaryEvents();

    // Auto-show guided tour for first-time visitors
    try {
      if (!localStorage.getItem("guidedTourCompleted")) {
        // Delay slightly so the page renders first
        setTimeout(showGuidedTour, 800);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // storage unavailable
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
